name: Kabin Bagale
title: SEAL Secure Exam Access System
problem: Colleges cannot stop students from opening other programs during computer-based exams.
abstract: SEAL holds the exam screen in one full-screen window and records each answer with a timestamp. Supervisors see live status for each seat and collect the answer files at the end.

name: Sandesh Dotel
title: ORIGIN Project Idea Originality Checker
problem: Student groups pick project titles without knowing past projects or other groups, so titles repeat every semester.
abstract: Students type a title with tags and a short description, and ORIGIN compares it with past projects and locked class ideas. It shows a score with the closest match and suggests a concrete new direction.

name: Anup Parajuli
title: Smart Inventory and Sales Management System
problem: Shop owners lose track of stock and daily sales because records stay in paper notebooks.
abstract: Shop owners record stock, purchases, and sales in one web app and see low-stock alerts each morning. The app prints bills, tracks profit by day, and warns before any item runs out.

name: Anjali Tamang
title: Disaster Relief Management System
problem: Relief groups cannot track victims, supplies, and volunteers in one place after a disaster.
abstract: Ward officers register affected families and list what each family needs, while donors pledge supplies against real demand. Volunteers pick delivery tasks from a live queue and mark each delivery complete with a photo note.

name: Abiral Bhandari
title: Library Management System
problem: Students queue at the library desk to borrow books while the librarian searches paper registers.
abstract: Students search the catalog online, reserve a book, and collect it from the desk with a return date stamped. The librarian tracks loans, fines, and available copies from one dashboard.

name: Aashish Maidali
title: Library Management System
problem: Two librarians manage one collection with paper cards, so the same book is promised to two students.
abstract: Students find books in an online catalog and scan a QR code at the desk to borrow or return in seconds. The system blocks double issue of one copy and lists defaulters with fines automatically.

name: Prayusha Upadhyaya
title: Crime Track Smart Crime and Case Management System
problem: Citizens file crime complaints on paper and never learn what happens to their case.
abstract: Citizens file a complaint online with photos and track each step from registration to closure. Police officers link evidence documents to the case file and verify each update before it reaches the citizen.

name: Rekha Mahat
title: Online Voting System
problem: Paper ballots need halls, long queues, and manual counting that takes a full day.
abstract: Voters verify identity once, cast one vote online, and see a receipt without revealing the choice. Officers publish results after the poll closes and anyone can audit the published totals.

name: Shreya Chhetri
title: ATM Simulation System
problem: Banking students learn ATM use from slides and never touch the real flow of PIN, balance, and cash.
abstract: The desktop app simulates card insert, PIN check, balance view, cash withdrawal, and mini statement on screen. Each transaction updates the practice account and prints a receipt slip for the student record.

name: Aakriti Shrestha
title: CafePOS Point of Sale Management System
problem: Cafe staff take orders on paper slips that get lost between table, kitchen, and counter.
abstract: Waiters punch orders on a tablet, the kitchen sees each ticket live, and the counter prints one final bill. Owners track daily sales by item and see which dish earns most each week.

name: Nitesh Shahi
title: Hospital Management System
problem: Hospital desks manage patients, doctors, and beds in separate registers that never match.
abstract: Reception books appointments, admits patients, and assigns beds from one screen with live availability. Doctors see their queue and patient history, and the pharmacy bills against the same visit record.

name: Nirjal Kasula
title: Employee Management System
problem: Small firms track staff attendance, leave, and salary in files that payroll never trusts.
abstract: Managers mark daily attendance, approve leave requests, and assign weekly shifts in one place. Payroll reads the same records and generates salary slips without retyping hours.

name: Sunil Chand
title: Student Management System
problem: Colleges keep admissions, attendance, and marks in three files that disagree at report time.
abstract: Staff admit students once, mark daily attendance by class, and enter exam marks against the same roll number. Class teachers print report cards and defaulter lists straight from the system.

name: Umanga Pokhrel
title: Weather Forecasting App
problem: Farmers and travellers plan the day without local rain and temperature guidance.
abstract: The app pulls station data and shows rain chance, temperature, and wind for each hour using past records and average trend from historical data. Users get a notification before heavy rain starts in their saved places.

name: Rebika Shrestha
title: Gym Membership Management System
problem: Gym owners track members, fees, and trainer slots on paper that expires with the notebook.
abstract: Members join a plan, book trainer slots, and pay monthly fees online with renewal reminders. Trainers see daily schedules and attendance, and owners track revenue by plan each month.

name: Saroj Timalsina
title: Job Portal
problem: Job seekers walk company to company with paper CVs while small firms never reach them.
abstract: Seekers post one profile with skills and apply to open posts in two clicks. Employers shortlist applicants, schedule interviews, and close the post when the seat fills.

name: Sushant Bhusal
title: JV Chatbot for Student Queries
problem: New students ask the same questions about routine, fees, and exams that staff answer a hundred times.
abstract: The chatbot answers questions from the college FAQ and replies in a guided dialog with links to the right notice. Unanswered questions go to a staff queue so the FAQ grows each week.

name: Samir Karki
title: Smart Menu Ordering System
problem: Diners wait for waiters to bring paper menus and take each order by hand.
abstract: Diners scan a QR code at the table, browse the live menu with photos, and send the order straight to the kitchen. Staff track each table status and print one bill at the end with split options.
